bioconda.name: rhizaeon
bioconda.summary: RhizAeon: Phylo-Attention Force Field Recombination Scanner
bioconda.description:
RhizAeon is a Rust-backed scanner for detecting and characterizing
recombination events in nucleotide sequence alignments. It projects
alignment columns onto a phylo-attention force field, screens candidate
recombinant taxa, verifies tracts under Fisher/Poisson significance
floors, and can emit JSON summaries plus standalone HTML dashboards.
